answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> Dawah & Tableeg Question ID: 37194 Country: India Title: I want to go to for 40 days in Allah's way in tabligh but my parents are sunni jamah and they do not like tabligh, but I am very addicted to tabligh and more I have got hidayah and knowledge from this tablighi brothers Question: I want to go to for 40 days in Allah's way in tabligh but my parents are sunni jamah and they do not like tabligh, but I am very addicted to tabligh and more I have got hidayah and knowledge from this tablighi brothers only and very much inspired by Maulana Tarique Jameel sahib but my dad has very wrong concept about tabligh. He just thought that in tabligh they brain washout from any responsibilities. My dad even does not allow me for 3 days or go to Markaz too. So how can I ask Allah for my parents understanding about tabligh. Any specific practice or any dua is there or any namaz? Answer ID: 37194 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 492/298/H=1433) Keep on taking care of your father and do not say anything him about tablighi jamah. However, with the advice of local tablighi jamah people request to some such people who have already spent their time in tablighi jamah that they should come to your father and talk to him a little about tablighi along with business and home related talking with wisdom and insight. If any outside jamah comes then the local people should get your father meet them and you should not be there that time. Recite the last ruku of 13 para [واذ قال ابراھیم رَبِّ اجْعَلْ هَـذَا الْبَلَدَ آمِناً ......... رَبَّنَا اغْفِرْ لِي وَلِوَالِدَيَّ وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ يَوْمَ يَقُومُ الْحِسَابُ سوره إبراهيم] before sleeping in the night or in tahajjud after performing tahajjud salah and make dua for your father. May Almighty Allah bestow him correct understanding and sense! Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
